h:
对于刚开始使用 ComfyUI 并且没有太多知识（我也是新手）但想要一个具有生成图像潜力的简单 UI 的人来说，这是一个理想的工作流程。

V2.6更新

-我终于有时间修复它，现在一切都应该再次正常工作。

致以诚挚的问候，并对延迟表示歉意：/

V2.5.1更新

-错误修复：D

V2.5更新

-添加了精炼机*。

-修复了由于 Compact Ksampler（它是效率节点和一些基本节点的融合）在工作流上传后更新后无法识别调度程序选择器输入而导致的错误：/

- 原版 V2 已更新，还修复了 Ksampler 错误。如果您对 2.5 不感兴趣。您必须下载新的 V2 版本（或自行重做 Ksampler）。

*Refiner是可选的，如果你平时创作中不使用Refiner，并且你认为不需要它，你可以直接删除整个精炼师组没有任何问题，工作流程将继续完美运行：D

V2来了！

改进：

- 您现在可以在同一节点添加和删除 LoRa，甚至可以使用开关禁用它们。

-您现在可以选择未来价值数百万美元的艺术品的长宽比。

- 现在更加紧凑了！

洛拉

它按其应有的方式工作，我认为在 V1 中 LoRa 无法正常工作。这不再是问题了:D

这是新的选择器：通过单击“+添加 Lora”按钮，您可以添加任意数量的 Lora。使用这些开关，您可以单独停用和激活它们（或按“切换全部”）。要从列表中删除 LoRa，只需右键单击它，就会出现此菜单：

纵横比

这似乎是一个小小的补充......但对我来说这是非常有用的，特别是当你改变很多的时候，因为一直手动输入“1024x1024”或“512x768”是相当无聊的。这是加载程序现在的样子：当您单击长宽比按钮时：这几乎是高潮。

提示

我牢记相同的目标：简化提示并得到我想要的。这就是我在提示中写的全部内容。1 女孩，apo积极的方面，绝对没有消极的方面（是的，我很懒，我知道），我选择了 Marcille（Dungeon Meshi）的 LoRa 和 Styler 节点中的几种样式，这就是结果：显然它并不完美，但我的意思是......我确实写了两个字......并且通过“使用元数据保存图像”节点，Civitai 在上传使用此工作流程创建的图像时可以识别元数据（不是全部，例如 LoRa，我仍然无法让它识别它们，但是，嗯，现在还好）。这是一个例子：正如您所看到的，所选样式也会根据提示保存在 Styler 节点中。我将继续努力寻找一种方法来获取所有元数据，就像 A1111 一样。

现在就这些了。如果您有任何意见或建议，请不要害羞：D

o.en:
An ideal workflow for people who are just starting to use ComfyUI and don't have much knowledge (I'm a newbie too), but want a simple UI with a big potential to generate images.

V2.6 Update

-I finally had time to fix it, now everything should be working normally again.

Best regards, and sorry for the delay :/

V2.5.1 Update

-Error fixes :D

V2.5 Update

-Added a Refiner*.

-Fixed a bug caused because the Compact Ksampler (it was a fusion of Efficiency Nodes and some basic nodes) didn't recognize the Scheduler Selector imput after an update, after the workflow upload :/

-The original V2 has been updated to fix the Ksampler bug as well. In case you are not interested in 2.5. You must download the new V2 version (or redo the Ksampler yourself).

*The Refiner is optional, if you don't usually use Refiner in your creations, and you think you don't need it, you can simply delete the wholeRefinergroup without any problem and the workflow will continue working perfectly :D

V2 is here!

Improvements:

-You can now add and remove LoRa from the same node, or even disable them with a switch.

-You can now select the aspect ratio of your future artwork worth millions.

-Now it's even more compact!

LoRa

It works as it should, I think that in V1 the LoRa didn't work properly. That's not a problem anymore :D

This is the new selector:By clicking the +Add Lora button you can add as many as you want. With the switches you can deactivate and activate them individually (or press Toggle All). To remove a LoRa from the list, simply right click on it and this menu will appear:

Aspect Ratio

It may seem a minor addition... but for me it's something very useful, especially when you change a lot, because manually typing ALL the time "1024x1024" or "512x768" is quite boring. This is how the loader looks now:And when you click on the Aspect Ratio button:It is almost orgasmic.

The prompt

I keep the same goal in mind: Simplify the prompt and get what I want. That's all I wrote in the prompt.1girl, apoin the positive, and absolutely nothing in the negative (yes, I'm lazy, I know), I chose a LoRa from Marcille (Dungeon Meshi) and a couple of styles in the Styler node and this is the result:Obviously it's not perfect, but I mean... I literally wrote 2 words.... And with the Save Image With Metadata node, Civitai recognizes the metadata when uploading an image created with this workflow (not all, the LoRa, for example, I still can't get it to recognize them, but meh, it's fine, for now). Here is an example:As you can see, the selected styles are also saved in the Styler node at the prompt. I will continue to work on figuring out a way to get absolutely all the metadata as well as A1111 does.

That's all for now. If you have any advice or suggestions, don't be shy :D
